name: H.H.Galaxy Co., Ltd.
summary: H.H.Galaxy Co., Ltd. specializes in providing a full spectrum of e-commerce operational services. The company's core offerings include managing online platforms and digital storefronts, overseeing platform distribution logistics, and crafting EDM (Electronic Direct Mail) designs. They also facilitate the procurement of various digital advertising spaces and offer agency services for web page administration. Additionally, H.H.Galaxy delivers targeted digital marketing and advertising strategies. The firm was established in 2013 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
